title: Wire Transfers and Payment Processing on Beige
summary: This document covers domestic wire transfers (fee $0.00; dual authorization required for amounts above $10,000), incoming domestic wires (50 included per month), and mobile check deposits (daily limit $100,000). It also covers out-of-network ATM fee rebates up to 50 per month and operational steps (payment templates, approval queues, reconciliation).
faqs: Is there a fee for domestic wire transfers, and is it always $0.00?
When do I need dual authorization for a domestic wire, based on the $10,000 threshold?
What are the monthly included number of incoming domestic wires (50 per month), and how should I use it?
What is the daily mobile check deposit limit ($100,000) and how should I plan submissions?
How many out-of-network ATM fee rebates are available per month (up to 50), and do I need to submit receipts?
What operational steps does this guide recommend for recurring payments, approvals, and reconciliation?
